# Technical Plan: 12GB GPU Routing for Nemotron-H Hybrid Inference

## Executive Summary
This plan addresses the latency-critical problem of fitting Nemotron-H hybrid inference (Mamba + attention + MoE + shared experts) onto a 12GB CUDA GPU. The architecture contains tensors that exceed GPU memory capacity when all experts are resident. The solution employs **selective GPU offloading** with **CPU RAM overflow** for expert tensors, preserving GPU residency for latency-sensitive Mamba, attention, and router tensors while routed experts page to CPU RAM.

## 1. Tensor Mapping & Memory Budget Analysis

### Critical Tensor Groups & Sizes (per layer, 4-bit quantized)

| Tensor Group | Exact Names (from `src/models/nemotron-h.cpp`) | Memory (4-bit) | Offload Strategy |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Mamba SSM** | `ssm_in`, `ssm_conv1d`, `ssm_conv1d_b`, `ssm_dt_b`, `ssm_a`, `ssm_d`, `ssm_norm`, `ssm_out` | ~1.8 MB | **GPU-Resident** (latency-critical, small) |
| **Attention QKV/Output** | `attn_norm`, QKV weights, `wo`, `wo_b` | ~3.2 MB | **GPU-Resident** (latency-critical) |
| **MoE Experts (Routed)** | `ffn_down_exps`, `ffn_up_exps`, `ffn_gate_inp`, `ffn_exp_probs_b` | **~28 MB/layer** (overflow to CPU) | **CPU RAM** (pageable, amortized cost) |
| **Shared Experts** | `ffn_down_shexp`, `ffn_up_shexp` | **~8 MB/layer** (overflow to CPU) | **CPU RAM** (per-token, low fan-out) |
| **NextN/MTP Draft** | `nextn.*`, `attn_norm`, QKV, `ffn_down_exps`, `ffn_up_exps`, `ffn_down_shexp`, `ffn_up_shexp` | ~8 MB/layer | **GPU-Resident** (draft overhead) |
